fact: Agence Ecofin reports SMTD-SA and Senegal Numerique commissioned on 5 October 2026 a fibre link at Kidira-Diboli joining the Malian and Senegalese backbones, giving landlocked Mali a route to submarine cables (2Africa, ACE, SAT-3 landing in Senegal) and described as an additional corridor to a pre-existing terrestrial axis it does not name.

SMTD-SA (Malian government information portal) states the Mali and Senegal national fibre backbones were interconnected and inaugurated on 5 October 2026 at Kidira-Diboli under ROA-BN, giving onward access to the submarine cable from Portugal and Cape Verde.
Afribone Mali says its international links run over optical fibre through Dakar and Abidjan to the ACE and MainOne submarine cables.
system: Afribone international links via Dakar and Abidjan
